gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-fs-literata: Literata reads like a classic serif with sturdy thin strokes and curves that stay wide open. Bruno Ace SC is the showier one, spreading flat-weight letters out like beads, while Literata does the quiet work of carrying text.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-fs-sentient: Sentient reads smooth and contemporary, its pinched apertures tucked in tight. Bruno Ace SC's laser-cut letters stay open and uniform, so the pair's strongest quality is that sharp split between open and closed shapes.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-literata: A horseshoe-wide c gives Cherry Swash its stamp, with diagonals as heavy as its verticals. Literata follows in a softer serif voice, so give it a modest size and let the heading carry the weight.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-sentient: Confident, heavy-bowled Cherry Swash sits against a body that feels tucked in and refined. And Sentient, a classic serif with pinched apertures, would read smoothly down a long page, its thin crossbars never turning fragile.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab reads grounded as a text serif, every lowercase letter standing tall and sturdy. And Funnel Display, drawn in spaghetti-like strands, looks best large, so let the slab's size be the one you nudge to taste.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-erode: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-thin strokes. Erode, a classic serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, gets a slightly generous size so its gentle weight shifts come through.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-hoover: Spaghetti-like strokes of one steady width define Funnel Display. It is the one to turn heads, and Hoover, a serif with short ascenders and a generous e, is the one to carry the reading.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-trench-slab: Trench Slab is a classic serif with caps and lowercase standing nearly level in height. And under Funnel Display's pen-like lines, a long page would feel dignified, dense and steady.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-domine: Loose pasta-like lines, drawn at a constant width, set Funnel Display apart from anything fussy. Domine, a text serif, then carries paragraphs with compact ascenders and roomy curves.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-esteban: Pen-line strokes, never varying. Esteban, a serif with oversized lowercase and a wide-open e, would settle into long paragraphs with a refined, classic feel.
